register.headline: Daniel's opening n229 dilation certificate, after Couzo and de Winter
register.source_checks: The author reports that his two exact rational checkers, verify_cert.py and verify_cert2.py, accept the certificate, with least pair separation 1.0e-12 and least wall clearance 5.0e-13. The source states the certificate is a dilation of a binary64 packing (search/packer/dilate_cert.py): centres and box scaled by 1 + 10^-12, coordinates rounded to rationals and each angle to a rational half-angle tangent, so every square is exactly unit; it certifies the upper bound only. No source program ran here.
register.credit: Credit Evan Daniel after Francisco Couzo's #672 packing, which refines Joost de Winter's #668, as the issue asks: the tilted structure is #672's and the upright part is rearranged. The work and the request were done with Claude (Claude Code) under Evan Daniel's direction.
